scope: Bounded discovery, not detector qualification; historical exposure remains explicit

objectives.hypothesis: Existing media and runtime can support a new controlled measurement
objectives.expectedEffect: Rights-eligible source-linked pilot without reserve access
alternatives: only derivative or reserved data available
objectives.design: Read registry, prior reports, available approved manifests and runtime
objectives.requiredData: Existing approved camera, synthetic and procedural controls
objectives.success: Exact parent, runtime, rights and source roles recorded
objectives.independentValidation: Hash checks, separate source/model-alias audit and refreshed GitHub lineage
objectives.result: 248 pilot parents and 46 separate consumed diagnostic sources; no reserved data or training
objectives.remainingUncertainty: Historical exposure; Unsplash not pristine; procedural templates not representative human art; no blanket commercial clearance

objectives.hypothesis: Spatial parent-child wavelet dependence adds information beyond marginal spectral statistics
objectives.expectedEffect: Origin-associated joint dependence surviving matched encoding
objectives.design: Three-scale Haar dependency instrument and spatially shifted parent-band null
objectives.requiredData: Real photographic, synthetic and non-AI digital images
objectives.falsification: No separation or separation entirely replicated by marginal baselines/null
objectives.success: Measurable incremental evidence with explicit uncertainty, or reproducible negative result
objectives.independentValidation: Independent Haar matrix, PyWavelets/scipy, 24 real-media repeats and all six high-case independent reproductions
objectives.result: New project measurement implemented; frozen scalar not qualified as synthetic evidence
objectives.remainingUncertainty: Near-tie floating arithmetic affects rank features; negative conclusion does not reject every multiscale method

objectives.hypothesis: A bounded new-observable pilot has a useful reproducible effect
objectives.expectedEffect: Discovery distributions and fixed decision rule
objectives.design: 40 photographs,40 synthetics,20 hard negatives preferred; limited predefined features
objectives.falsification: No feature survives both camera and hard-negative comparisons
objectives.success: All attempts reported; scalar rule frozen before held-out scoring
objectives.independentValidation: Repeat extraction and independent rank/pairwise metric calculation
objectives.result: 99 actual discovery parents; 792 rows; fixed high-score direction failed, no post-hoc reversal
objectives.remainingUncertainty: One unavailable discovery negative feature; selected-negative cutoff is not independent specificity proof

objectives.hypothesis: Any pilot effect survives source/generator grouping and codec controls
objectives.expectedEffect: Held-out-family effect and unique rescue without unacceptable new FP
objectives.design: Disjoint generator and hard-negative template families; matched size, JPEG, resize, shifted dependence null
objectives.falsification: Effect disappears, reverses, or induces material subgroup FP
objectives.success: Bounded advance or rigorously rejected mechanism
objectives.independentValidation: Separate auditor recomputed membership, AUC, FPR, unique rescue and exact pixel/source hash joins
objectives.result: 149 heldout parents; 1192 rows; original recall1/59, worst-caseFP1/90; only one unique source rescue, absent atJPEG75/resize
objectives.remainingUncertainty: Pillow/Sharp identical pixels, so unseen-encoder generalization untested; no fresh programme confirmation or same-content causal pairs; wide FPR intervals
